name: Flower Festival
author: NGTofficial
description: Fall to the floor after the structure at 22% as the ship. Fly under the cube portal at 23% to stay as the ship and avoid the 4x speed portal. Navigate through the gameplay without touching any portals until 30% where you can enter the cube portal. Play through the level at a slower speed until 40% where after getting the cube portal and hitting the blue pad, you will fall to the floor. Free to the end from there.
